r: What are you doing here around these crates?

oluag_2.m: Oh these. They are nothing. Never mind them. That grave over there is nothing to worry about either.

oluag_boxes_1.m: No no, nothing suspicious at all. It's not like they contain any contraband or anything like that, hah!
r: What was that about a grave?
OK then. I guess I didn't see anything.

oluag_grave_1.m: Yeah, OK. So there is a grave right over there. I promise I had nothing to do with it.
r: OK then. I guess you didn't have anything to do with it.

oluag_grave_10.m: And he told me something about that he didn't dare tell anyone.
r: Maybe he didn't dare tell Wrye?

oluag_grave_11.m: Yeah sure, probably. He had set down here to camp, but got attacked by some monsters.

oluag_grave_12.m: Apparently he was not as strong a fighter as, for example, someone like me. So the monsters wounded him too much for him to last the night.

oluag_grave_13.m: Sadly, they also must have taken any loot with them, since I could not find any on him.

oluag_grave_14.m: I heard the fighting and only managed to get to him after the monsters had fled.

oluag_grave_15.m: So, anyway. Now he is buried over there. Rest in peace.

oluag_grave_16.m: Lousy kid. He could at least have had a few coins on him.
r: Thank you for the story. Goodbye.
Thank you for the story. Shadow be with you.

oluag_grave_2.m: Well, when I say 'nothing', I really mean nothing. Or maybe just a little bit.

oluag_grave_3.m: OK, so maybe I just had a little bit to do with it.
r: Do I have to beat it out of you?

oluag_grave_4.m: Relax, relax. I don't want any more fights.

oluag_grave_5.m: There was this kid I found. He had almost bled to death.

oluag_grave_6.m: I managed to get a few sentences out of him before he died.

oluag_grave_7.m: So I buried him over there by that grave.
r: What were the last sentences you heard him say?

oluag_grave_8.m: Something about Vilegard and Ryndel maybe? I didn't really pay attention, I was more interested in what loot he had on him.
r: I should go check that grave. Goodbye.
Rincel, was that it? From Vilegard? Wrye's missing son.

oluag_grave_9.m: Yeah, that might be it. Anyway, so he said something about fulfilling a dream to see the great city of Feygard.

oluag_grave_return.m: Look, I already told you the story.

wrye.10: Jolnor in Vilegard chapel wants me to talk to Wrye in northern Vilegard. She has apparently lost her son recently.
wrye.20: Wrye in northern Vilegard tells me that her son Rincel has gone missing. She thinks that he has died or gotten critically hurt.
wrye.30: Wrye tells me that she thinks the royal guard from Feygard are involved in his disappearance, and that they have recruited him.
wrye.40: Wrye wants me to go search for clues as to what has happened to her son.
wrye.41: I should go look in the Vilegard tavern and the Foaming Flask tavern north of Vilegard.
wrye.42: I heard of a boy being in the Foaming Flask tavern a while ago. Apparently he left to the west of the tavern somewhere.
wrye.80: To the northwest of Vilegard I found a man that had found Rincel fighting some monsters. Rincel had apparently left Vilegard by his own will to go see the city of Feygard. I should go tell Wrye in northern Vilegard what happened to her son.
wrye.90: I have told Wrye the truth about her son's disappearance.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
